name: Magma geode
description: a lump of black cooled slag with a lava core, split by glowing orange cracks, like a cracked geode, floating and slowly rotating

poses.stand: a rough round lump of dark cooled slag the size of a head, hovering, split by glowing orange cracks with a white-hot lava core showing through, small floating pieces of slag orbiting it
poses.struck: just hit and cracking: the lump split by wide bright cracks, the core blazing, pieces flying off
poses.dead: burst into two small glowing shards of slag flying apart

idle.action: drifts in place, rotating slowly, the cracks pulsing orange

hurt.action: is struck, wobbles, a crack spreading

die.action: cracks across, swells white-hot and bursts open into two small glowing shards
